title: Security Best Practices
description: Implement security best practices for authentication and authorization including passwordless auth, MFA, session management, and security hardening.
longDescription: This module covers security best practices for authentication and authorization systems. You will learn passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), session management and fixation prevention, CSRF and XSS protection, rate limiting, and security hardening for authentication endpoints.
whatYouLearn: Implement passwordless authentication with magic links and WebAuthn
Add multi-factor authentication (MFA) with TOTP and SMS
Manage sessions securely with proper expiration and fixation prevention
Protect against CSRF and XSS attacks in authentication flows
Implement rate limiting and security hardening for auth endpoints
